topology_reasoning: The target mask appears to contain two long, independently routed waveguides over a 120 um × 4 um footprint. The traces start separated near top/bottom edges, move toward each other over the first ~30 um, run nearly parallel through a central exchange/coupling window, then diverge back to opposite edges by the output end. This is modeled as a two-arm crossover/adiabatic exchange motif with polyline centerline control points and a fixed guide width.
